description: This file defines the base interface 'OpenmrsObject' for the OpenMRS project, including methods for getting and setting unique identifiers and UUIDs.

classes.name: OpenmrsObject
classes.description: A base interface for all OpenMRS data classes, providing methods for identifier and UUID management.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the object.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the object.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Returns the universally unique identifier for the object.

methods.name: setUuid
methods.description: Sets the universally unique identifier for the object.
